name: 6 Card Omaha
description: 6 Card Omaha: six hole cards each, five community cards. Use exactly two hole cards and three board cards for best five-card hand. Pot Limit common; more drawing and stronger hands than 4-card Omaha. 2-9 players.

overview.description: 6 Card Omaha: six hole cards each, five community cards. Use exactly two hole cards and three board cards for best five-card hand. Pot Limit common; more drawing and stronger hands than 4-card Omaha. 2-9 players.

history.origins: Omaha poker is a relatively recent casino variant that emerged in the USA in the early 1980s. Six Card Omaha is a modern "Big O" extension in which each player is dealt six hole cards but must still use exactly two hole cards and three board cards at showdown.
timeline: 1980s: Omaha poker introduced in American casino card rooms as a shared-card variant of Texas Hold'em.
1990s–2000s: Pot Limit Omaha spreads through casinos and tournaments worldwide.
2000s–2010s: High-card-count variants such as Five- and Six-Card Omaha (Big O) appear in live and online mixed-game rotations.

setup.players: Two to nine players. Optimal four to six.
setup.deck:
Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
setup.dealing: Six hole cards each, face down; then five community cards (flop three, turn one, river one). Dealing clockwise.

rules.objective: Make the best five-card hand using exactly two of your six hole cards and three of the five board cards. Win the pot at showdown.
rules.gameplay: Preflop betting (player to left of big blind starts; big blind acts last). Dealer burns one, deals three community cards (flop); betting round. Burn one, deal one (turn); betting round. Burn one, deal one (river); final betting round. Showdown: active players show all six hole cards; best five-card hand using exactly two hole and three board wins. Pot Limit common.
keyRules: Six hole cards; five community cards
Must use exactly two hole and three board for hand
Pot Limit typical; other limits possible

strategy.basic: Use exactly three board and two hole cards; prefer hands that make nuts or redraws.
strategy.intermediate: Board texture matters more with 6 cards; wrap and pair draws are strong.
strategy.advanced: Range construction and blocker effects; 6-card equities differ from PLO.
tips: Must use exactly 2 from hand, 3 from board.
More drawing hands; full houses and straights common.

variations.name: Six Card Omaha High
variations.description: Standard version; only the best high hand wins the pot. Pot Limit common.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: This variation uses the same engine structure as the base game; it only labels the pure high version in rules text.

variations.name: Pot Limit vs No Limit
variations.description: Pot Limit: maximum bet or raise equals current pot size. No Limit: any amount up to stack.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: This variation only changes betting structure (Pot Limit versus No Limit) described in rules, not the underlying engine phases.

scoring.description: Pot to best hand at showdown.
scoring.winCondition: Make the best five-card hand using exactly two hole cards and three board cards. Win the pot at showdown.
